newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Burundi troops kill three Tanzanians, says paper.
newsitem.headline: Burundi troops kill three Tanzanians, says paper.

text.p: Burundian soldiers shot and killed three Tanzanian villagers after crossing into western Tanzania's Kigoma region, the semi-official Daily News said on Friday.

The soldiers, possibly looking for suspected Hutu rebels, killed a farmer, his wife and child in a maize field this week near Mkingo village, the newspaper said quoting govrnment officials. It gave no further details.
Burundi's military-backed government has accused Tanzania of allowing Hutu rebels to stage attacks on Burundi from its territory. Tanzania maintains a heavy military presence along the border.
About 200 Burundian Hutus cross the border into Tanzania each day to escape the country's low-level civil war, the U.N. refugee agency said this week.
